purpose: Govern delayed, dated, source-attributed conflict-context geometry without replacing administrative geography or implying live tactical awareness.
separation_rules: Administrative country and subdivision partitions remain independent base geography.
Conflict snapshots never rewrite canonical country or subdivision identity.
Control, contested-area, humanitarian-access and historical-front geometry must be separately typed.
A rendered conflict snapshot must always expose observation date/period and source bundle.
Unknown or approximate dates remain unknown/approximate; they are not promoted to exact timestamps.
No live tracking of individual troops, vehicles, aircraft, ships, units or operational routes.
No tactical prediction, targeting, or inferred current unit location.

geometry_meanings.control_area_snapshot: Dated source representation of control over an area; not sovereignty.
geometry_meanings.contested_area_snapshot: Dated source representation of a contested area.
geometry_meanings.historical_front_snapshot: Historical/delayed front-line representation suitable for retrospective context.
geometry_meanings.event_aggregate: Aggregated event geography over a declared period.

activation_policy.current_mode_rule: Current mode may show only snapshots explicitly promoted as reviewed delayed/current-context data; otherwise require an as-of date.
activation_policy.as_of_rule: Select only snapshots whose declared observation period contains or precedes the requested date according to the dataset-specific policy.
activation_policy.changed_between_rule: Compare independently valid snapshots; do not interpolate an invented front between them.

display_contract.required_boundary_text: Conflict context is dated and source-attributed. It does not replace administrative geography and is not live tactical tracking.

empty_state.message: No reviewed conflict snapshot geometry is committed yet; a guarded historical event-aggregate acquisition path is available.
